mechanism_claims.claim_text: S4-derived dermaseptin analogs show phenotypic inhibition of ZIKV PF13 infection in HMC3 cells when virus is pre-incubated with peptide before infection.
direct_assay_types: FACS infected-cell readout with 4G2 anti-envelope antibody
mechanism_claims.limitations: This supports antiviral activity in the pre-incubation assay; it is not by itself direct molecular proof of a membrane-lysis mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The authors infer that activity occurs at an early viral-cycle stage because peptide-virus pre-incubation preceded HMC3 infection.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Timing supports an early-stage/virion-directed interpretation but does not identify a precise viral or host molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Viral-envelope damage or membrane interaction is treated as an author-proposed mechanism requiring follow-up permeability assays, not as directly demonstrated evidence.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper proposes viral envelope interaction/lysis but explicitly points to additional RNAse/propidium monoazide-style tests as future confirmation.

caution_findings.reason: Mechanism is bounded to phenotypic antiviral activity plus author inference; no direct viral-envelope damage assay was locally available.
